QUOTE: "The effect is consistent and conclusive." METRIC: num_seeds ISSUE: 4 seeds with no baseline SE cannot support a "conclusive" claim, contradicting the caveats just stated.
QUOTE: "The gap between the measured PGR and the baseline exceeds twice the reported standard error" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: Without a baseline SE this is not a valid significance test of the difference, only a comparison to a point value.
